retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1970s studio portrait featuring a male subject in a black leather jacket with vibrant red accents against a flat, neutral gray-blue background, topped with bold, high-contrast serif typography.
triggerTerms: vintage album cover layout with red serif text

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait of a man with dark hair, wearing a black leather jacket over a red shirt. The lighting is soft but directional, creating subtle shadows on the face. The background is a solid, desaturated blue-gray. The top edge features large, all-caps serif text in two colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a flat, desaturated background
High-contrast red accents in clothing mirrored by red typography
Text aligned to the top edge, spanning the width of the frame
Leather texture providing specular highlights against matte skin tones
coreInvariants: Primary color pop of red against neutral tones
Studio-lit male portrait with direct eye contact

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame in a medium-close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright red cuff/collar areas.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold red text at the top left, move across the title, then down to the subject's face and hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third around the typography and the flat background surrounding the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated blue-gray background and black leather jacket.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant primary red in the shirt and the first half of the text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and white highlights on the jacket.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red elements contrasts sharply with the low-saturation background and dark values of the jacket.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two-color split within a single typeface family to distinguish artist from title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme stroke contrast and vertical stress.
Provides the elegant, high-fashion look typical of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with 70s-style dark hair, wearing a black leather jacket and a bright red collared shirt, posed with one hand near his temple, against a solid slate-gray background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two words in bold red Didone serif on the top left and two words in bold black Didone serif on the top right, aligned in a single row across the top.

verificationChecks: Is the text a high-contrast serif?
Is the red color vibrant and consistent between text and clothing?
Is the background a flat, neutral tone?
Is the subject wearing a black leather jacket?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the red accent color
Ensure the leather jacket has realistic highlights
Confirm the background is a solid, desaturated color
Check that the text is aligned to the top edge
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Leather Jacket + Red Accent + Didone Header
